cand.title: World Hospitality Expo Mexico 2027 powered by HOSTELCO
cand.organizationName: Expo Guadalajara and Fira Barcelona International
cand.excerpt: Rank 5: medium evidence and direct Expo Guadalajara relevance; venue is committed, so current-edition accessibility is constrained and the lead is not an assumed open room block.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant organizer-side contacts are Atenea Chevillotte Delgado, Fira Barcelona International’s International Events Director for México Hospitality Expo, and Sanderson Melo Sacerdys, the event’s published International Sales Executive. Atenea is the event-leadership escalation route; Sanderson is an accessible international commercial routing contact. Neither source proves hotel-contract signing authority. Hotel executives appearing as speakers should not be represented as accommodation buyers.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed activity dates: 6–8 July 2027, 10:00–18:00, at Expo Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. These are the venue calendar’s event dates, not a news publication date, and fall within November 2026–May 2028. No 2028 edition date was established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: strong city-hotel accommodation and ancillary-meeting fit, rather than a resort/incentive buyout. Crucially, Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is already on the official 2026 Hoteles sede list, with event-rate validity 6–8 October 2026. Using the supplied Expo-adjacent, 216-room product profile, pursue exhibitor teams, visiting buyers, speakers and organizer accommodation rather than replacement of the exhibition floor. Marriott publishes 12 event rooms, 1,654 square metres of event space and a largest-space capacity of 500, supporting a proposed briefing, reception or small side-meeting offer; no such 2027 function is confirmed.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara publishes Salón Jalisco A y B for 2027. This establishes the announced exhibition venue, not disclosure of an executed contract. The venue is not a competing hotel. Published host-hotel arrangements found are explicitly for October 2026; they do not establish 2027 hotel commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: First edition: 6–8 May 2025, Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco B, C, D–e as listed by the venue. Second edition: 6–8 October 2026, Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco A y B. The announced 2027 edition remains at Expo Guadalajara. The documented change is timing and halls, not destination rotation. Do not infer a fixed month or a confirmed 2028 cycle.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status for 2027: unknown/unconfirmed, not verified open or closed. The official Hosted Buyer programme advertises lodging at a host hotel, round-trip flights and ground transfers, demonstrating an organizer-linked accommodation pathway; the page does not identify its applicable edition, hotel, allocation or contracting intermediary. The official allied-hotels page separately publishes direct hotel reservation channels for 2026. No 2027 RFP, room-block size, housing agency appointment or sourcing deadline was established.
findings.organizationStructure: The event is coorganized through Expo Guadalajara and Fira Barcelona International, using Fira’s HOSTELCO brand. It is a B2B HORECA trade exhibition, not an association-owned congress or a corporate incentive programme. Expo Guadalajara is both coorganizer and announced exhibition venue. No separate accommodation agency, PCO or DMC mandate was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2026 official allied-hotels page lists Barceló Guadalajara, The Westin Guadalajara, VOCO by IHG, Sheraton Guadalajara Expo and European Life Style Executive Suites. Explicit event-rate validity is shown for the first four; the European Life Style entry does not state dates. This is a multi-hotel competitive set, not evidence of exclusivity or a sold-out primary hotel. No documented overflow, pickup, displaced demand, guaranteed allocation or 2027 competitor appointment was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First reconcile the hotel’s own 2026 event-rate arrangement and realized pickup with its sales/revenue team. Then contact the event’s published commercial channel, info@mhe.mx / +52 33 1865 6427, and Sanderson Melo Sacerdys, smelo@firabarcelona.com, referencing Sheraton’s official 2026 listing. Request routing to the 2027 accommodation/Hosted Buyer lead, confirm whether Sheraton is renewing, and establish selection timing, incumbent commitments, eligible buyers and room-night requirements before quoting inventory. Seek Atenea Chevillotte Delgado’s direction if ownership of the hotel programme remains unclear. Offer a conditional July 2027 guestrooms-plus-briefing proposal only after requirements and availability are verified.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 14 November 2026, the October 2026 edition and its published Sheraton event-rate window have expired; use them only as relationship evidence. For the next edition, July 2027, the main exhibition venue is announced, but accommodation accessibility remains unresolved. Venue commitment does not itself close guestroom sourcing. Sheraton’s historical inclusion makes renewal/re-entry more defensible than treating this as a cold open-block opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize renewal and increased share for the confirmed July 2027 edition, using Sheraton’s documented 2026 host-hotel inclusion. Explore official hotel-list continuation, hosted-buyer accommodation eligibility and direct exhibitor/delegation stays. These are proposed sales paths, not confirmed demand. Later editions remain relationship-development prospects; no 2028 dates, rotation or open tender were verified.
